root_cause: Cached DriverKit 286 IIG callers omit IORPC.kernelContent; current XNU OSMetaClassBase::Invoke rejects NULL with kIOReturnIPCError, triggering IOSystemStateNotification::initialize assertion.
fix: Initialize kernelContent to the generated local message content header in the IIG compatibility conversion, guarded by KERNEL; handle synchronous and one-way callers. Preserve pinned cache hashes, native Invoke validation and StateNotification assertions.

current_observation: IIG StateNotification initialization panic is fixed and absent in three hardware runs (two identical EFI runs with a 30-second watchdog, one with 90 seconds). BSD MAC and buffer initialization and CoreAnalyticsHub start complete. No further XNU output or panic is observed before watchdog reset, including the longer run; the exact subsequent wait is not yet localized. Missing IORTC is a source-based candidate (IOKitInitializeTime waits up to 30 seconds), not a confirmed runtime stop. Manifest/profile handoff errors are visible but have not been established as the stop cause. Full system boot is not complete.
current_blocker: Waiting for an IOMedia root device with Content=Apple_HFS. RTC/calendar, pthread and network/lo0 initialization passed. No panic observed in the final test. No mountable root filesystem has been handed off; full userspace boot is not complete.
device_recovery: Firmware reboot captured; USB transport not responding after cleanup.
watchdog_observation_note: Older 90-second values describe the requested bridge setting; effective hardware duration was not calibrated. RTC tracing later confirmed and fixed the IORTC wait.
